text.style: fill: #1a1a1a; font: 700 20px 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Airdrie: how each map divides the city

text.style: fill: #444444; font: 9.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Bar widths are shares of Airdrie's 74,100 residents at the 2021 census (the city counted 85,805

text.style: fill: #444444; font: 9.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: in its 2024 municipal census). The majority gives the city two divisions where most people are

text.style: fill: #444444; font: 9.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: from Airdrie; the minority gives it one.

text.style: fill: #1a1a1a; font: 700 10.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Majority proposal · 2 divisions, both mostly Airdrie

text.style: fill: #1a1a1a; font: 700 10.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Minority proposal · 4 districts, one of them mostly Airdrie

text.style: fill: #666666; font: italic 8.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: The minority's Airdrie East holds 54.7% of the city and is 89.6% Airdrie. Calgary-Airdrie and

text.style: fill: #666666; font: italic 8.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Calgary-Foothills-Airdrie West hold 45% between them; in both, Calgary residents outnumber Airdrie's. Counting

text.style: fill: #666666; font: italic 8.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: only pieces with at least 2% of the city's people, the split is three pieces to two.

text.style: fill: #666666; font: 7px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; text-anchor: end

g.text: Source: 2021 census areas over Elections Alberta's official 2026 boundaries (analysis/scripts/airdrie_split_shares.py).
